title: RNA Extraction from Cockroach Gut Microbiota
author: Kara Tinker
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jz6cp9e

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Materials
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary stocks and materials for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Prepare GTC Lysis Buffer (HP Total RNA Kit): Add 20μl B-mercapoethanol per 1mL of buffer (stable for 2 weeks at room temperature).
Prepare RNase-free Lysozyme: 30 mg lysozyme per 1 mL of TE buffer; store aliquots at -20°C.
Add 25-40mg glass beads to new tubes.
Prepare QVL Lysis Buffer (MicroElute RNA Clean Up Kit): Add 20μl B-mercapoethanol per 1mL of buffer (stable for 1 week at room temperature).

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Thaw and aliquot the cockroach gut lumen samples.

substeps.instruction: Remove samples stored in 100μl RNALater from -80°C and thaw on ice.
Remove half of the sample for RNA extraction and return the remaining half to -80°C.
Preheat thermomixer to 30°C.

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend Samples
steps.instruction: Clean the samples and resuspend them in lysozyme buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 200μl PBS to each sample.
Centrifuge at 5,000 x rcf for 5 minutes.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cockroach samples in 50μl lysozyme/TE buffer.

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Inhibit RNases and incubate the samples to facilitate lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 4μl Superase-In RNase inhibitor to each sample.
Vortex for 30s.
Incubate at 30°C for 10 minutes at 300rpm.

steps.title: Bead Beating and Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical lysis using glass beads and GTC Lysis Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 700μl GTC Lysis Buffer to each incubated tube and mix by pipetting.
Transfer the mixture to a new tube containing glass beads.
Vortex for 30 seconds, then place on ice for 30 seconds; repeat this cycle 3 times (total bead beating time: 2 minutes).
Centrifuge on short.

steps.title: DNA Clearance
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the lysate using a clearance column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer lysate to a DNA clearance column in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x rcf for 1 minute.
Discard the DNA clearance column and save the flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to a HiBind RNA column.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume (700μl) of 70% ethanol to the lysate and mix by pipetting (do not centrifuge).
Apply the sample to a HiBind RNA column in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 60 seconds at room temperature.
Discard flow-through and reuse the collection tube.
Note: Since the column capacity is 700 μL, repeat this process twice, adding half of the volume each time.

steps.title: RNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the bound RNA to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Place DEPC water in 70°C hybridization oven and preheat thermomixer to 37°C.
Add 500μl of RNA Wash Buffer I to the column and centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 60 seconds; discard flow-through.
Add 500μl of RNA Wash Buffer II by pipetting directly onto the column and centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 60 seconds at room temperature; discard flow-through.
Repeat the RNA Wash Buffer II step a second time; discard flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Dry the column and elute the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Place the HiBind RNA column in a new 2mL collection tube and centrifuge for 2 minutes at maximum speed.
Transfer the column into a clean 1.5 mL centrifuge tube and add 50μl of DEPC water.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at maximum speed.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Perform routine DNase treatment using the Turbo DNA-free procedure.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume 10X Turbo DNase Buffer (5μl) and 1μl TURBO DNase to the RNA and mix gently.
Incubate at 37°C for 20-30 minutes.

steps.title: RNA Clean Up
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA using the MicroElute RNA Clean Up Kit.

substeps.instruction: Add 350μl of QVL Lysis buffer and mix by vortexing.
Add 250μl of 100% Ethanol and mix thoroughly by vortexing.
Apply sample to MicroElute LE RNA Mini Column in a 2mL collection tube and centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 15 seconds; discard flow-through.
Add 500μl of RNA Wash Buffer II and centrifuge at 10,000 x rcf for 30 seconds; discard flow-through.
Add 500μl of RNA Wash Buffer II and centrifuge at 13,000 x rcf for 2 minutes to dry the membrane; discard flow-through and collection tube.

steps.title: Final RNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Perform final drying and elution of the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the column into a new collection tube, open the cap, and centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 minutes; discard flow-through and collection tube.
Transfer the column to a clean 1.5mL microfuge tube and pipette 30μL DEPC water into the column.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at max speed to elute RNA.
Adjust the final sample volume to 100μl by adding 44μl of DEPC water (following Omega Bio-Tek’s E.Z.N.A. MicroElute RNA Clean Up Kit July 2014).
